description: Header file defining the ApplicationX11 class for managing X11 windowing, event handling, and rendering in a Starboard-based application on Raspberry Pi 4. It includes methods for window creation, event processing, buffer swapping, and video frame management.

classes.name: ApplicationX11
classes.description: Manages X11 windowing, event handling, and video rendering for a Starboard application on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.description: Constructor for ApplicationX11, with version-dependent parameters.
